[website] If video playback is not working, the site offers a direct download of the video, but that link was broken (pointed to .mov instead of the actual .mp4).

added package-infos to lots of packages, updated the javadoc in these, and made lots of private/package private methods 'public' in packages that aren't actually public API. Tumi asked for this, and I can imagine this is useful for others who are hacking add-ons to lombok. The package-info files clarify that we aren't committing to long-term stability of anything except the stuff directly in the lombok package, lombok.experimental, and lombok.extern.

The inNetbeansEditor test is made after all the validations are made to the annotated field, and generates a regular getter for validations, Naviagator and autocompletion.
[trivial] fixed typos in test files.

[#626] introduction of formatting options triggered a longer standing bug about wonky timing on replacing Options with LombokOptions, causing javac to complain about not recognizing i.e. a Getter annotation when using it more than once in a file.
[#625] Changelog entry for this issue

[#625] Instead of '31' as a prime number for hashCode(), use something else. 31, probably owing to its inclusion in Effective Java, is overused, as proven by Maaartinus in issue 625. Switching to 277 instead. Also, 1231/1237 pair used for booleans has been replaced by 2591/2609.

Added code to NOT add @SuppressWarnings to things if a @SuppressWarnings is already there. Lombok itself can't ever do that anyway (we don't add @SW except to things we just generated fresh), but some lombok extension builders do, and this helps them.
